Record Components:
name - The class name
annotations - The annotations
modifiers - The modifiers
annotationType - Whether this class is an annotation type
interfaceType - Whether this class is an interface or trait
enumType - Whether this class is an enum
typeParameters - The declared generic placeholders
superType - The super type
interfaces - The interface types
constructors - The constructors
methods - The methods
fields - The fields
properties - The properties
enclosingTypeName - The enclosing type name for inner classes
nativeType - The native Scala compiler object
nestedTypeNames - The binary names of the classes declared inside this one, for a class read from the classpath; a source class's are extracted as classes of their own

  • Method Details

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object other)
      A declaration is itself: two are equal only when they are the same object. Record equality would compare every member, type and annotation beneath, and core keeps these as keys of a hash map -- so every lookup was hashing the whole model of the class.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
